# Stack

## Purpose

Define the technologies, frameworks, libraries, tools, runtimes, and infrastructure used by the project.

This document provides the technical environment required to understand and implement the system.

---

## Scope

This document covers:

* Programming languages
* Runtime environments
* Frameworks
* Libraries
* Databases
* Frontend technologies
* Testing tools
* Development tools
* Build tools
* Infrastructure technologies
* Version constraints

This document does not cover:

* Business rules
* Domain concepts
* Architectural responsibilities
* Coding conventions
* Feature requirements
* Artifact-specific behavior
* The rationale behind major technical decisions

## Technical Decisions

Major decisions about technology selection belong in ADRs.

This document should record the technologies currently in use, not the complete rationale behind why they were selected.

---

## Evolution Rules

* Changes to the project stack must be reflected in this document.
* Major technology changes should be documented through an ADR.
* Feature implementation must use the technologies defined here unless an approved decision allows otherwise.
* Deprecated technologies should be removed or clearly marked when no longer supported.
